PhD Researcher in Mathematics at the University of Warwick.

My research focuses on stochastic interacting systems, Markov chains,
opinion dynamics and social learning.

## Research interests

- Markov chains and mixing times
- Interacting particle systems
- Opinion dynamics
- Mean-field stochastic systems
- Multi-agent learning
- Stochastic multi-armed bandits

## Current research

I am currently interested in the relationship between microscopic
stochastic dynamics and macroscopic behaviour, particularly phase
transitions, metastability and critical slowing.
